The agent should have focused on authoritative sources that clearly state the building opposite the Proclamation Gallery, but instead, it relied on multiple sources that sometimes gave different answers. This led to uncertainty and the need for more definitive confirmation.

So, the error was that the WebSurfer agent didn't consistently retrieve authoritative confirmation of the building opposite the Proclamation Gallery, leading to conflicting results. The agent should have continued searching until a definitive source was found or used map-based verification to confirm the location.
